overloads.semanticRole: Highlights a section of text in the named form object, identified by its object name (string), because the leading * marker is passed.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when object should be interpreted as an object name (string) identifying a form object, rather than a direct field/variable reference.

overloads.semanticRole: Highlights a section of text in the given form field or variable, passed directly by reference (no leading * marker).

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the leading * is omitted and object is passed as a direct field or variable reference instead of an object name.

constraints: If startSel equals endSel, no text is highlighted and the insertion point is simply placed before the character at that position.
If endSel is greater than the number of characters in object, all characters from startSel through the end of the text are highlighted.
